name: What's the difference between a garage conversion and a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a garage conversion and a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion transforms an existing structure into a new living space, utilizing the existing footprint, foundation, and often the roof. This typically makes it a more cost-effective and faster process, as it avoids new foundation work and extensive exterior changes. A home addition, conversely, involves building entirely new square footage onto your property, which is generally more expensive, requires more extensive planning, and takes longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion repurposes existing space, typically making it faster and more affordable than a home addition, which builds entirely new square footage.
